digest.component_or_area: reconciler in-flight probe / fsck-repair lock guard
propositions: The claim that link-audit --repair can never run because _reconciler_in_flight fails closed on a ModuleNotFoundError for rebar_reconciler is withdrawn as a misdiagnosis.
The probe resolves engine_dir() and inserts it into sys.path before importing rebar_reconciler, so the import succeeds and check_pass_lock reads the lock correctly.
A discriminating experiment showed check_pass_lock honors lease expiry (returns False once the lease expires and True while a lease is live), confirming the guard is correct in both directions.
Earlier repair refusals coincided with a genuinely live reconciler lease, so refusing and leaving the tracker unchanged is intended behavior, not a defect.
The claim that fsck --repair is affected identically is retracted since it shares the same correct function.
_reconciler_in_flight has no test coverage, which is a genuine coverage gap but not a defect.
